text:
maria: Heads-up TidalHealth wants to run a 4-week POC with a customer-finetuned model `tidecore-14b-ft`. Requirements: Private deployment (VPC), customer KMS, audit logs, and an embeddings endpoint. They expect bursty API at ~40 rps and want 95th percentile latency <150ms. Can we confirm catalog onboarding path + blockers?

asha: Quick clarifying q: are they supplying a single artifact or a model+tokenizer bundle? Any adapter layers?

jim: They sent `tidecore-14b-gguf.tar.gz` containing `model.gguf`, `spm.model` (sentencepiece), `tokenizer_config.json`, and an adapter `adapter.pt`. Also included an evaluation prompt set and a short data retention ask.

leo: Runtime notes: sentencepiece is supported but we must ensure tokenizer config has `add_bos`/`add_eos` flags consistent with our serving pipeline. Adapter in PyTorch needs to be merged or loaded as LoRA-compatible; we support LoRA-like adapters but will run a merge test.

maria: Security flagged two items from their questionnaire: (1) requirement for granular audit logs for every inference call, (2) data residency constraint (EU-only for customer data).

security-bot: [sec-scan] vendor questionnaire parsed  issues: KMS key policy unspecified, data residency requires EU region deployment only, and retention TTL needs confirmation. Recommend Redacted PCI fields review.

jim: For audit logs we can emit request/metadata (model id, route, token counts) but cannot log raw input by default; need customer approval. EU-only is fine in Private if we provision deployment in eu-central-1. KMS: we need a Key ARN with a policy granting our deploy role kms:Decrypt/kms:GenerateDataKey.

leo: Performance: 14B at 40 rps with <150ms P95 is tight. Two options: (A) Dedicated pool with pinned warm-up and KV cache across replicas; (B) Offer an engineered fallback to `tidecore-6b-distill` for saturated periods. Also consider half-precision vs 8-bit quant — 8-bit will reduce memory but may alter outputs.

maria: They asked about deterministic outputs and token-level cost. They said they will run evals that require stable responses (no sampling). Also want embedding similarity to match their in-house vector store (which uses cosine).

leo: Deterministic = set `temperature:0, top_p:1` and disable sampling. For embeddings we should validate vector dimensionality and normalization. We can expose embed endpoint separate from generation.

deploy-bot: [artifact-scan] tidecore-14b-gguf.tar.gz scanned: `spm.model` found, vocab size 50,120, adapter detected (PyTorch state_dict). No blocked licenses. Suggest tokenizer config check and adapter merge test.

maria: Action items: Jim -> draft KMS policy snippet and EU deployment checklist. Leo -> tokenizer compatibility + adapter merge smoke test + small eval against their prompt set. Asha -> draft POC SOW including fallback behavior and audit log semantics.

jim: KMS snippet (example) I will request from customer:```json
{
  "KeyId": "arn:aws:kms:eu-central-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345",
  "Policy": "Grant RedwoodDeployRole kms:Decrypt,kms:GenerateDataKey"
}
```

leo: Tokenizer quick check (local):```bash
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer_config.json'); print(t.get_vocab_size())"
```

maria: Pricing heads-up: 14B dedicated pool with EU hosts will require committed capacity; if they accept int8 quant and 2 replicas for redundancy we can give a POC price estimate. Asha, include a pricing delta for int8 vs fp16 and fallback usage.

asha: Will do. Also confirm with infra whether we can enable per-request audit flags (masking raw inputs) during the POC.

deploy-bot: [ticket] Created: #SW-4599 "TidalHealth POC  tidecore-14b-ft onboarding" assigned: leo,jim,asha. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/SW-4599

jim: I'll request the customer provide the KMS key ARN and a signed DPIA for EU data residency.

leo: Running adapter merge now; will post regression results (BLEU/ROUGE-ish metrics they provided) within 6 hours.

maria: Thanks all. If we identify any licensing or IP red flags during adapter merge we'll pause onboarding. Ping me if blocker. :+1:
